test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Electrician) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A train travels from A to B at a speed of 40 km/hr and returns from B to A via the same route at a speed of 10 km/hr. Find the average speed (in km/hr) of the train during the two-way journey.
solution:
**Given:**

Speed from A to B = 40 km/hr

Speed from B to A = 10 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Average speed = (2 × Speed₁ × Speed₂) ÷ (Speed₁ + Speed₂)

**Calculation:**

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 40 × 10) ÷ (40 + 10)

⇒ Average speed = (2 × 400) ÷ 50

⇒ Average speed = 800 ÷ 50

⇒ Average speed = 16 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 16 km/hr.**
